Title: Aarav and the Family

Cast

1. Aarav - 9 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Kavita - 38 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Rishabh - 11 years, friend
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Aarav stands in the living room. Kavita stands near him.]

Aarav: "Let's do something fun today."

[Aarav eats his breakfast at the table.]

Aarav: "Listen!"

[Aarav munches on an apple.]

Kavita (surprised): "Careful!"

[Aarav reads a storybook.]

Aarav: "Careful!"

[Aarav studies for his exam.]

Kavita (happily): "Well done!"

[Aarav's phone rings and he answers it.]

Aarav (gently): "Exactly right."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Aarav stands in the courtyard. Kavita stands near him.]

Kavita: "So, here we are!"

[It starts to rain.]

Kavita (excited): "That's great!"

[A strong wind starts blowing.]

Aarav: "Careful!"

[Aarav feeds the dog.]

Aarav: "Mom, are you okay?"

Scene 3: The road - Day

[Aarav stands by the road. Kavita and Rishabh stand near him.]

Rishabh: "Aunty, look over here."

[Aarav gets into the car.]

Kavita: "Yes, of course."

[Aarav hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Aarav: "One more time!"

[Aarav pedals his bicycle hard up the road.]

Aarav: "That was such a fun day!"
